description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerGroup controller class within the Opencart admin module. It manages tasks related to customer groups, including listing, generating JSON data files, retrieving info, and cleaning up generated files within the admin panel.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer group tasks within the Opencart admin backend, handling listing, details, and cleanup of customer group data files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes customer group task list by clearing old tasks and adding fresh ones.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing customer group data and creates related tasks.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates a detailed JSON file for a specific customer group, including custom fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing customer group JSON files from the server.
